steps.python:
v = ${v0}
print('SINGLE', v)
assert v['layout'] == 'single' and v['active'] == 0 and not v['maximized'], v
assert [p['shown'] for p in v['panes']] == [True, False, False, False], v
assert any(c.endswith('overview') for c in v['cameras']), v['cameras']

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat
im = Image.open(r'${out}/00_quad_lit.png').convert('RGB')
ps = ${lit}['panes']
w = min(p['rect']['width'] for p in ps) // 4
h = min(p['rect']['height'] for p in ps) // 6
def crop(p):
    r = p['rect']
    x, y = r['x'] + (r['width'] - w) // 2, r['y'] + r['height'] * 11 // 20 - h // 2
    return im.crop((x, y, x + w, y + h))
c = [crop(p) for p in ps]
d = [sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(c[0], c[i])).mean) / 3 for i in range(1, 4)]
print('LIT DIFFS', d)
assert all(x < 4 for x in d), d

v = ${quad}
print('QUAD', v)
ps = v['panes']
assert v['layout'] == 'quad' and v['active'] == 0 and all(p['shown'] for p in ps), v
assert [p['mode'] for p in ps] == ['lit', 'normals', 'wireframe', 'material'], ps
r = [p['rect'] for p in ps]
assert r[0]['y'] == r[1]['y'] and r[2]['y'] == r[3]['y'] and r[0]['x'] == r[2]['x'] and r[1]['x'] == r[3]['x'], r
assert r[1]['x'] >= r[0]['x'] + r[0]['width'] and r[2]['y'] >= r[0]['y'] + r[0]['height'], r

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat
im = Image.open(r'${out}/01_quad_modes.png').convert('RGB')
ps = ${quad}['panes']
w = min(p['rect']['width'] for p in ps) // 4
h = min(p['rect']['height'] for p in ps) // 6
def crop(p):
    r = p['rect']
    x, y = r['x'] + (r['width'] - w) // 2, r['y'] + r['height'] * 11 // 20 - h // 2
    return im.crop((x, y, x + w, y + h))
c = [crop(p) for p in ps]
d = {(i, j): sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(c[i], c[j])).mean) / 3 for i in range(4) for j in range(i + 1, 4)}
print('MODE DIFFS', d)
assert all(x > 8 for x in d.values()), d

cam = [c for c in ${quad}['cameras'] if c.endswith('overview')][0]
v = app.actions.run('view.view', index=3, camera=cam)
assert v['camera'] == cam and v['mode'] == 'material', v

p = ${bound}['panes'][3]
print('BOUND', p)
assert all(abs(a - b) < 1e-3 for a, b in zip(p['eye'], [0.4, -3.6, 1.5])), p

a, b = ${pre}['panes'], ${moved}['panes']
print('MOVED', b[2])
assert ${moved}['active'] == 2 and b[2]['active'] and not b[0]['active'] and b[2]['mode'] == 'unlit', b
assert all(abs(x - y) < 1e-3 for x, y in zip(b[2]['target'], [0.0, 0.0, 0.4])) and b[2]['eye'] != a[2]['eye'], (a[2], b[2])
assert all(b[i]['eye'] == a[i]['eye'] and b[i]['target'] == a[i]['target'] for i in (0, 1, 3)), (a, b)

c = {a['id']: a for a in app.actions.list()}
assert c['view.contacts']['checked'], c['view.contacts']

c = {a['id']: a for a in app.actions.list()}
assert not c['view.contacts']['checked'] and c['view.layout_split']['checked'], (c['view.contacts'], c['view.layout_split'])

v = ${split}
assert [p['shown'] for p in v['panes']] == [True, True, False, False] and v['panes'][0]['mode'] == 'lit', v

v, s = ${max}, ${split}
print('MAX', v['panes'][1])
assert v['maximized'] and [p['shown'] for p in v['panes']] == [False, True, False, False], v
assert v['panes'][1]['mode'] == 'normals' and v['panes'][1]['rect']['width'] > 1.9 * s['panes'][1]['rect']['width'], (v, s)

v = ${single}
assert not v['maximized'] and [p['shown'] for p in v['panes']] == [False, True, False, False], v
